title: Juicy Spicy Norwegian Ground Pork Meatballs
description: A spicy and creamy Norwegian dish featuring ground pork, perfect for a date night, made with halal-friendly ingredients. This recipe combines the richness of pork with the boldness of spices.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the egg, milk, salt, black pepper, cayenne pepper, and paprika.
Add the chopped onion, breadcrumbs, and ground pork to the bowl, mixing until just combined.
Use your hands to shape the mixture into meatballs, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter.
Place the meatballs on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving a little space between each meatball to allow for even cooking.
Bake the meatballs in the preheated oven for 18 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the meatballs are baking, mix the sour cream with a little water to thin it out, if desired, for serving.
Serve the meatballs hot with the sour cream sauce spooned over the top.
